lucy: Heads up — nightly DAST run failed to upload findings to artifacts bucket. CI shows KMS Decrypt denied.

lucy: Error snippet from job:
```
2026-03-21T02:12:33Z ERROR: google.kms.v1.Decrypt permission denied for projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/security/cryptoKeys/dast-artifacts: caller=serviceAccount:scanner-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

dan: That was my change earlier to tighten keystore bindings (PR #489). I scoped the keystore policy to a set of SAs and may have left out scanner-runner. Oops.

priya: Sec-bot, create ticket and page oncall? We need to know how long artifacts are unavailable and whether policy is breaking migrations.

sec-bot: Alert created: INC-2026-799 — sdlc/dast-artifact-kms-failure. Severity: P2. Notifying oncall.

ops-bot: Noted. Canary deploys unaffected. Temporary workaround: artifact ingestion will retry but will keep failing until KMS binding restored.

lucy: Is there a safe short-term fallback to unencrypted storage (with tight TTL) so triage can continue? We need to avoid leaking secrets in plain S3/GS objects.

dan: Suggestion: create a tmp bucket with bucket-level ACL locked to security team and CI writes there with lifecycle rule to delete objects after 24 hours. We can add an extra header to indicate "ephemeral-unencrypted:true". I'll spin it up if approved.

priya: Approve temporary bucket for incident-only use. Meanwhile, can someone run an audit-log query to prove who removed the SA binding? Use Cloud Audit Logs: 
```
gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="SetIamPolicy" AND resource.labels.keyRingId="security"' --project=redwood-prod --limit=50
```

dan: I already ran a query — shows my account changed keystore policy at 2026-03-20T21:08:01Z, reason: tighten-keystore-prune. I'll open a follow-up to avoid manual edits.

lucy: Can we also add a pre-merge CI check that compares PR diffs for keystore IAM or keystore-policy.yaml changes and blocks the merge unless a reviewed exception tag is present?

priya: Yes — SEC-679 created: "premerge-keystore-binding-check". Add a linter step that fails if keystore policy removes SA bindings without SEC-approved wart.

dan: I'll add the linter and a test that runs `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` against a test key to ensure the scanner SA has roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter before merge.

sec-bot: INC-2026-799 updated: mitigation in progress.

ops-bot: dan restored the SA binding. CI retried and DAST artifact upload succeeded on build 9876.

lucy: Great — please document the incident playbook in the security runbook. Minimal playbook commands to rebind and to verify audit logs I recommend adding: 
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding dast-artifacts \
  --location=global --keyring=security --member=serviceAccount:scanner-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter

gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.serviceName="cloudkms.googleapis.com" AND protoPayload.methodName:"SetIamPolicy"' --project=redwood-prod --limit=10
```

priya: Also add a checklist item to notify compliance and attach the incident number and retention notes. Recommend 90-day access log retention for auditability.

dan: Will push SEC-679 changes and the playbook doc. Marking INC-2026-799 resolved after verification.

sec-bot: INC-2026-799 closed by dan (mitigated, follow-up SEC-679 created)"
